requirements.text: Both operator Deployments consume the immutable Phase 40 exact ceiling ConfigMap.
Both operators use one shared Rust ceiling contract and deterministic SHA algorithm.
All ten Phase 40 exact ceilings are required and cross-field validated at operator startup.
The standard operator injects all ten exact ceilings into generated reference-worker Jobs.
The distributed operator injects all ten exact ceilings only into Stage::Reasoner Jobs.
Non-reasoner distributed Jobs remain free of exact-reasoner ceiling environment variables.
Generated reasoner Jobs and Pods carry the Phase 40 ceiling-bundle SHA annotation.
Work-spec SHA identity includes the exact Phase 40 ceiling bundle.
Reconciliation rejects pre-existing Jobs whose Phase 40 ceiling hash differs.
Reference-worker recomputes and verifies the operator-provided ceiling-bundle SHA before work.
Phase 40.12 online admission and Phase 40.11 worker enforcement remain unchanged.
